title: 年忘れディナーショー

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Raise the curtains for a glamorous dinner and opera show hosted by and starring none other than… me! But could this be a twist of fate?

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Scheduled at the same exact time, the so-called Golden Generation are holding an event of their own.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I concede the achievements to their names… However! I am the true star!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Observe—I shall captivate the hearts and minds of the crowd as only the lead role can! So inspired, a grand feast with my followers ensues.
